expected_effects: Cup is lifted from the table.
preconditions: Target cup is reachable and not occluded.

expected_effects: Cup is moved horizontally over the grey tray.
Cup is lowered towards an empty slot.
Gripper opens to release the cup.
preconditions: Cup is seated in the tray slot.
Cup is stable enough to support its own weight.

goal_interpretation: Select one of the two visible green cups, transport it to the grey tray, and place it securely into an available empty slot within the tray boundaries before releasing.

nodes.description: Initial scene with two green cups and a grey tray on the table.
observable_conditions: Two green cups are present on the table surface.
Grey tray is stationary with visible empty slots.
unknown_conditions: Exact weight and center of mass of the cups.
Friction coefficient between cup base and tray surface.

nodes.description: One green cup is securely held by the robot gripper.
observable_conditions: Gripper is closed around the cup body or handle.
Cup is lifted slightly off the table surface.
unknown_conditions: Whether the selected cup is the intended target if multiple exist.

nodes.description: The green cup is positioned inside an empty slot of the grey tray.
observable_conditions: Cup is aligned with a tray compartment.
Cup base is in contact with the tray bottom.
unknown_conditions: Precise fit tolerance between cup diameter and slot width.
Stability of the cup once placed without holding.

nodes.description: Green cup is released and resting stably in the grey tray.
observable_conditions: Robot gripper is open and retracted.
Cup remains upright within the tray boundaries.
unknown_conditions: Confirmation that the task is fully complete per user intent.

objects.description: Green cylindrical cup with handle located on the left side of the table.
Green cylindrical cup with handle located behind or adjacent to the first cup.
Rectangular grey tray with internal compartments/slots positioned on the right side.

physical_checks: Verify grasp stability by lifting the cup slightly before full transport.
Check for collision between the cup handle and tray edges during insertion.
Confirm the cup sits flat in the tray slot before releasing grip.
Ensure the selected cup is not stuck to the table surface due to suction or friction.
